arrival: Welcome to Ember. Choose a comfortable position. Your eyes can stay open. You can pause or stop at any time. Nothing needs to be forced.
natural: Let your breathing find its own rhythm. There is no need to make it deeper or slower. You might notice the support beneath you, or a sound in the room.
comfortable: If it feels comfortable, allow a gentle breath in, and an easy breath out. Follow your own pace, without holding your breath. Return to natural breathing whenever you like.
arrive: Notice something steady around you. It might be the ground, the light, or an ordinary sound. Let that be enough for this moment.
focus: Choose one simple anchor, perhaps a sound or the feeling of your feet on the floor. When attention wanders, gently return. Wandering is part of the practice.
kindness: You might offer yourself a few kind words. May I meet this moment with patience. If those words do not fit, choose your own, or simply rest with the sounds around you.
rest: There is nothing to finish right now. Let your attention settle somewhere comfortable. You can keep your eyes open, change position, or stop whenever you wish.
space: There is some space here to practice in your own way. Let the sounds come and go. You do not need to empty your mind.
return: If you have become distracted, there is no need to start over. Notice where you are, and gently choose what to attend to next.
close: As this practice comes to a close, notice the room around you. You might move your fingers, look toward the light, and take your time with whatever comes next.
restClose: The guidance will end here. You can keep resting, or stop and return to your day in your own time. Nothing more is asked of you.
